name: Is it better to hang drywall yourself or hire a professional contractor?

mainEntity.name: Is it better to hang drywall yourself or hire a professional contractor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hanging drywall yourself can save upfront labor costs, but professional installation avoids time-consuming fixes and uneven walls. Drywall sheets are heavy, awkward to carry, and challenging to fasten straight without proper lifts and tools. Achieving clean seams requires precise mudding and feathered edges, which often takes DIYers weeks of trial and error to blend properly. Hiring a general finish contractor like HH Remodeling ensures square corners, seamless joints, and a ready-to-paint surface while keeping the project on a predictable schedule.
acceptedAnswer.description: Hiring a professional ensures flat seams, square corners, and faster turnaround, avoiding the heavy lifting and difficult mudding work of DIY projects.
